prompt: A unified team competed in the 1992 Summer Olympic games. How many years old was the first leader of the largest member nation of that team at the time of the game?
answer: The largest member of the 1992 Unified Team was **Russia**. Its leader at the time, **President Boris Yeltsin**, was born on February 1, 1931, making him **61 years old** during the Barcelona Olympics.
